Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting agencies from adopting rules that exceed federal standards without legislative authority.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring legislative authority for agencies toadopt rules that exceed federal standards; and adding a new section tochapter 34.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 34.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After January 1, 2004, no agency may adopt a rule that exceeds afederal standard without specific legislative authority. Thelegislature may grant such authority pursuant to a request by anagency. A requesting agency shall present to the appropriate standingcommittees of the house of representatives and the senate: (1) A written justification detailing the unique reasons whyWashington state policy must exceed federal policy; and (2) A costbenefit analysis that clearly outlines the economicimpacts for Washington's business or other regulated entities.
